text:
zoe-cs: Heads-up: new customer Nimbus Health stuck on onboarding. Their browser SDK init returns 401 then floods 429s, can't complete sample. They use CloudFront + a service worker.

zoe-cs: Logs: `[2026-03-20T14:02:10Z] auth 401 missing header "X-Client-Tag"`, then rapid `429 rate_limiter remaining=0`.

sam-dev: Likely two issues: CDN/service-worker stripping custom X- headers -> 401; parallel client-side fanout from smoke tests -> 429.

james-sdk: Ask which SDK bundle (CDN vs packaged) and paste init snippet. Quick fix: move calls behind a minimal server-side proxy to keep key secret and reduce parallel client requests. Will add clearer 401 message and a 429 backoff in next patch.

kevin-infra: I can apply a short quota bump to unblock. Recommend keep-alive and connection pooling on their side.

ops-bot: Temp quota +50/min applied to org_nimbus until 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z.

maria-cs: Nimbus is nervous; if blocked >48h mark as renewal risk. I'll offer a 1-week trial extension and schedule a 30m pairing debug today. Zoe will coordinate.

zoe-cs: Sending checklist + serverless proxy snippet, booking call now. Will update thread after pairing. :thumbsup:
